after=$(sudo -n sha256sum /srv/reports/access-proof.txt | awk '{print $1}')
test "$before" = "$after"
test ! -e /srv/reports/reader-should-not-exist.txt
test -e /srv/reports/access-proof-dir/peer.txt
printf 'content_hash_unchanged=%s\n' "$after"
